EmailTemplate.description: Details for making an appointment at GWCC to learn about transfer options
EmailTemplate.name: TRN GWCC Schedule
EmailTemplate.subject: Schedule an appointment to discuss transfer options at GWCC!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University! You can schedule an appointment to discuss your ASU transfer options at Gateway Community College every Thursday from 8:30 a.m. – 4:30 p.m. You can follow the directions below to schedule an appointment online.
1. Go to transfer.asu.edu/maricopa. 2. Click Make an Appointment on the right-hand side of the page, choose Gateway Community College as your school and click Go. 3. Available appointment times will appear on the calendar (Thursdays only). For future weeks, click Next at the top of the calendar. 4. Click Make an Appointment on the date and time that works best for you. Submit the contact form that appears. After submitting your contact information, be sure to confirm your time to make the appointment.
The ASU office at GWCC is located in the IE building in the Advisement area (located in Enrollment Services).
Want another option to see what it’s like to be a Sun Devil? We’d love to speak to you on one of Arizona State University’s four campus locations to discuss your transfer options. Appointments are held Fridays from 8:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Please follow the directions below to schedule an appointment online.
1. Go to http://transfer.asu.edu/friday/week. 2. Available appointment times will appear on the calendar (Fridays only). For future dates, use the drop-down option under View appointments by week, then click Go. 3. Click Make an appointment on the date and time that works best for you (the ASU office location will be listed before you schedule an appointment). Submit the contact form that appears. After submitting your contact information, be sure to confirm your time to make the appointment.
A confirmation email with the location will be emailed to you. While you’re on campus, we also hope you find your fit by scheduling a campus tour at http://visit.asu.edu.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
